name: gila monster
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-08, tools/creaturegen/herps/gila.py): the GILA MONSTER, Heloderma suspectum, 50 cm. Heavy and stout: a broad blunt rounded head on a thick neck nearly as wide, small dark eyes; a broad depressed trunk low on short strong sprawled legs, five short thick toes on each foot with sharp curved claws (`horn`s); a short FAT tail (one `sweep` along its four links) (its fat store), thick nearly to its end and rounded off blunt. BEADED skin (the osteoderms' bead scales: `scales`), black and pink-salmon (paints, colour only): the BANDED form (H. s. cinctum, base) broad black crossbands over the back with ragged edges, black flecks in the pink between, black rings round the tail; the RETICULATED form (H. s. suspectum) black blotches scattered over the pink, leaving a broken net; head, legs and feet black with a few pink flecks. Coats: banded, reticulated (`when: banded` / `reticulated`); variant `young` (.4, a hatchling: the bands bright and clean). A slow waddle, the trunk swinging, the heavy tail less.
